figs.name: bourdon-tube-pressure-gauges-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to choose C type, spiral or helical Bourdon tube and dry or liquid filled gauge
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to choose a Bourdon tube gauge: helical for very high pressure, spiral for fine low pressure, C type otherwise, then dry or liquid filled.
figs.after_h2: Types of Bourdon Tube Compared: C Type, Spiral and Helical

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">

<text x="583" y="438" font-size="17" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="600" y="418" width="190" height="60" rx="10" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
